title: chat-filenode: Space root placement gaps vs FileNode -19
description:
Found while making Space roots 0..n (8g3r fix, 2026-11-02); predates that change, not fixed there. Verified against editor's copy ~/GIT/draft-gondwana-jmap-filenode (566c2b6) - confirm against posted -19 before acting.
1. Name collisions: FileNode forbids two siblings with the same parent and name (~L265); top-level nodes (parentId null) are all siblings in an account, so roots of different Spaces in one account cannot share a name (e.g. two 'Files'). More roots per Space makes this likelier. Options: roots need not be top-level (but then a root could sit inside another Space's tree), server-chosen names, or document that clients pick unique names.
2. Top-level create needs mayCreateTopLevelFileNode (~L135, L617, L1872); chat-filenode only requires manage_space. Say how they combine.
3. Cross-Space moves: nothing stops moving a non-root node from one Space's tree into another Space's tree (or out to account top level), which changes who can see it. Draft forbids moving roots only.
